home.title: The human body, layer by layer.
home.body: Turn the model, peel back skin and muscle, and tap any structure to learn what it is and what it does, in English or Bahasa Indonesia.
home.note: For learning only. Not medical advice. Written content is a draft awaiting review by an anatomy educator.

about.title: About this model
about.disclaimer: AnatoSphere 3D is for learning. It doesn't diagnose conditions or recommend treatment, and it doesn't replace medical education.
about.limits: The model is based on one adult male. Some structures aren't in the source dataset, such as latissimus dorsi, rectus abdominis, masseter, temporalis and the muscles of facial expression. The lungs appear as airways and blood vessels only, because the dataset has no mesh for their outer surface. Shapes have been simplified to run in a browser.
